paragraphs: Premium web effects, animated components and intelligent UI. One HTML attribute. Any stack. Free forever.

Border beams, liquid glass, page transitions, a liquid modal and drawers, scroll-scrubbed video, a chat widget, cards, smart forms, a WebGL 3D loader, text reveals and more: 52 effects and components. A kit for putting them inside your own page builder. And intelligent UI: blocks an AI writes as JSON (match cards, lineups, standings, tables, charts, tickets…) that render while they stream, on your site or inside Claude and ChatGPT.
features: Any stack. Plain HTML, Webflow, Tailwind v4, React and Next.js (Server Components included), a WordPress plugin and an MCP server.
CSS first. Six effects are pure CSS and twelve more run in CSS with a JavaScript upgrade; the rest use a 46 KB gzip runtime with no dependencies (or register only the ones you use).
Accessible by default. prefers-reduced-motion everywhere, text effects stay readable for screen readers, everything works from the keyboard.
Never hides content. Hidden "before" states only apply once the runtime runs, with a CSS failsafe if it never boots.
Cheap when idle. Loops pause off-screen, pointer effects sleep until the mouse moves, Save-Data devices get a lighter version.
